plan_notes.relevance_test: Keep only items where AI actually advances or intersects scientific research or method. Drop pure AI-industry noise (funding, compute, hiring). Clinical and patient-facing items belong to medicine, so route them there and do not file them under science.
plan_notes.safety_note: Life-science queries are limited to protein structure, enzymes, therapeutics, drug discovery, genomics and cell biology. Do NOT pick pathogen-enhancement, gain-of-function, virus/toxin design or bioweapon-adjacent stories, because they halt the run. Swap the pick instead of rewording it.
plan_notes.recency_hint: Monday run. The window ends 2026-10-11T22:00:00Z, so new items are mostly Sunday weekend features (New Scientist, Quanta, Universe Today, Space.com, Live Science, The Conversation reposts on Phys.org) and Sunday EurekAlert/Phys.org reposts of late-week papers; Monday-embargoed Nature papers land after the window. WebSearch site: results skew evergreen, so the librarian should harvest outlet RSS / sitemap_news (phys.org, techxplore, sciencedaily, newscientist, quantamagazine, universetoday, space.com, livescience, thequantuminsider, physicsworld, eurekalert) for items from the last 24-36h. Weekend yield is thin, so the floor of 3 will likely need the sequential recovery pass.
